event spacetime

  • CURIE: gmeow:eventSpacetime
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventSpacetime
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/events

A spacetime slice of an event, expressed as a gmeow:LocationState that carries location, time interval or instant, pose, and optional velocity relative to an explicit reference frame (Principle 11). Reuses LocationState rather than minting a parallel 4D class. Multiple slices may coexist for the same event.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Event -> gmeow:LocationState

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:eventSpacetime from gmeow:Event to gmeow:LocationState when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Event, gmeow:LocationState
